edition: BDRC W4CZ5370, Mongolian Kanjur, Beijing red xylograph 1718–20
identification: Text and folio span from Ligeti's catalogue (1942–44), read from the rKTs handlist (www.rkts.org, 'Mongolian printed Kanjur, handlist prepared from Ligeti's catalogue'). BDRC has no outline for W4CZ5370. Each page's printed Chinese margin (section, volume, folio) was read by eye and agrees with the Ligeti location. Derge parallel: Esukhia derge-kangyur e-text (commit a582cf471b), all 10 Derge volumes are among the 53 that passed alignment in #5665. Passage located proportionally (Mongolian folio within the Ligeti span → side within the Derge span; derge-targets.json).
columns_method: Ink projection profile per page (column pitch ~48 px at 2000 px width on ordinary leaves, ~63 px on decorated opening leaves), checked by eye on v001, v047, v049, v066. ±1.
columns_read_definition: A column counts as read only if the emitted text, or its English, corresponds to that column's content. No emitted line corresponded to any column on any page, so every 'read' is 0; the lines Flash emitted are listed separately.
